mapper.select: SELECT * FROM drama_download_task WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drama_download_task (user_id, drama_id, status, content_ids_json, total_count, completed_count, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dramaId}, #{status}, #{contentIdsJson}, #{totalCount}, #{completedCount}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE drama_download_task SET status = 'RUNNING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE drama_download_task SET completed_count = #{completedCount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE drama_download_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', file_path = #{filePath}, file_name = #{fileName}, completed_count = total_count, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE drama_download_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
